title: San Marino & Bologna
introTitle: A tiny country and one of Italy's great cities.
intro: The day begins with a drive across northern Italy to the Republic of San Marino for a short visit high above the surrounding countryside. From there, the route turns toward Bologna for lunch and time in its historic center before returning to Brescia for the evening.

stops.name: Brescia
stops.description: Leave Brescia and begin the drive southeast toward San Marino.

stops.name: Piazza della Libertà — San Marino
stops.description: Spend a short time in the historic center of San Marino, including Piazza della Libertà and its sweeping views across the surrounding countryside.

stops.name: Piazza Maggiore — Bologna
stops.description: Stop in the heart of Bologna for lunch and some time around Piazza Maggiore and the surrounding historic center.

stops.name: Brescia
stops.description: Return to Brescia after a day through San Marino and Bologna.
